title: The project showcase got a link cleanup
summary:
A day of tending the community project list: fewer dead links, refreshed tables, and one less misleading URL.

Dead links were removed across the community project categories, and several listings now point to working demos or repositories. Link-checking scripts were also organized for future cleanup.

The README and PROJECTS.md tables were refreshed after the cleanup, including an updated VibeCoder listing. The README now notes that external project URLs may become unavailable.

The toai.chat listing no longer includes an invalid website URL; its description, author credit, and repository link remain.
